methodology.absent_categories: Unobserved categories remain null, not measured zero traffic. Explicit zero-token rows remain zero; zero baselines cannot define growth.
methodology.architecture: Within-bucket shares use the bucket's full reported token denominator, including unknown named models and the unnamed other tail. Classified volumes are observed lower bounds, while growth is sensitive to model mix and daily top-50 censoring.
methodology.comparison: Full UTC calendar months: January has 31 days and September has 30. Headline growth uses mean tokens per day.
methodology.context_buckets: Source request-context labels are retained verbatim. Exact numerical boundaries and request-length classification rules are not inferred.
methodology.coverage: A day is observed when at least one ranking row exists. Full calendar coverage is required for monthly metrics; observed rows cannot prove upstream completeness.
methodology.interpretation: These rankings do not measure cache hits, cached-token share, state bytes, memory residency, offload traffic, or storage demand. The newsletter's cache metrics come from a different analysis.
methodology.missingness: Missing dates are not zero-filled. Incomplete months suppress totals, daily means, indices, and comparisons; partial observed totals are separately identified.
methodology.ratios: Bucket-to-text ratios compare independently filtered token volumes; they are not request shares and do not assert mutually exclusive or exhaustive buckets.
methodology.reconciliation: Bucket sums are numerical diagnostics only. Equality with all-text totals does not prove bucket semantics or request-level coverage.
methodology.token_scope: Input plus output tokens, using provider-dependent tokenizers; not request counts, input-only lengths, or unique information.
methodology.traffic_scope: OpenRouter public text-token rankings; source excludes private/ZDR traffic.
